name: search_before_acting
description: Scheduled task must call memory__search with correct user_id as first action. Reproduces the user_id hallucination bug where agent used 'user_1234' instead of real scoped_id.
scenario: Search Yahoo Auctions for high-quality Minolta 85 1.7 listings. Compare results with previously saved listings and notify the user only of new high-quality additions.
